zh: 比较一个子序列和 t 的字典序，只看第一个不同的位置：在那之前它与 t 的某个前缀完全相等，一旦出现更大的字符就永远更大，出现更小的字符就永远更小。
从左到右逐个处理 s 的字符，维护 dp[j]=目前恰好等于 t 前 j 个字符的选法数，以及 greater=已经严格大于 t 的选法数。已经更大的选法无论选不选当前字符都还更大；等于 t 全串的选法再追加任何字符也会变大。
dp[0]=1，greater=0。对每个字符 c：先令 greater=greater*2+dp[m]；再让 j 从 m-1 倒序到 0，若 c>t[j] 则 greater+=dp[j]，若 c==t[j] 则 dp[j+1]+=dp[j]（倒序保证同一个位置不会被用两次）；每步都对 1000000007 取模。最后输出 greater。
en: Comparing a subsequence with t lexicographically only depends on the first differing position: before it, the subsequence equals some prefix of t; a larger character makes it greater forever, and a smaller one makes it smaller forever.

Process the characters of s from left to right, keeping dp[j] = number of choices equal to exactly the first j characters of t, and greater = number of choices already strictly greater than t. A choice that is already greater stays greater whether or not the current character is taken, and a choice equal to all of t becomes greater once any character is appended.

Start with dp[0]=1 and greater=0. For each character c: first set greater = greater*2 + dp[m]; then for j from m-1 down to 0, if c > t[j] add dp[j] to greater, and if c == t[j] add dp[j] to dp[j+1] (going backwards keeps a position from being used twice); reduce everything modulo 1000000007. Print greater at the end.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Let dp[j] count the subsequences currently equal to exactly the first j characters of t, and let greater count the choices that are already strictly greater. A new character can extend a greater state, or become greater at the first point of difference; update the match lengths from back to front to avoid using a position twice.

## Correctness

Every subsequence falls into one of three groups according to its first difference from t so far: already greater, still equal to some prefix, or already smaller. The already-smaller ones can never recover and are ignored; the already-greater ones stay greater whether or not the character is appended. For a state equal to a prefix, taking the current character leads to exactly one of three cases: it matches, it becomes greater at the first difference, or it becomes smaller at the first difference. These transitions are mutually exclusive and exhaustive.

## Complexity

Time O(|s||t|), space O(|s|+|t|) including the input.
